summary: Keep homes usable when catalog models are unavailable
breakingChanges: Unavailable models now render as placeholders while preserving item IDs, placements and connections. Update Cabane in HACS, restart Home Assistant and reload to get this recovery behavior. Structural errors remain blocked; no saved fields or schema versions change.

history.summary: Explain newer workspace formats and automate matching HA releases
breakingChanges: Unknown fields remain blocked. Older panels must update in HACS before opening newer homes; the message now explains update, restart and reload steps.

history.summary: Ship the expanded rug catalog with workspace upgrade guidance
breakingChanges: Existing rug model and variant IDs remain supported. Workspaces using the new rug styles require this matching integration release; older panels must update through HACS before opening them.

history.summary: Animate garage door opening and closing smoothly
breakingChanges: No persisted data or model IDs change. Existing homes remain compatible; update the panel to receive smooth garage-door motion.

history.summary: Add the woven rattan bell pendant catalog preset
breakingChanges: Existing homes remain compatible. Homes using rattan-bell-pendant require the matching panel release; older panels must update before loading this new model.

history.summary: Make rattan bell pendants bindable light devices
breakingChanges: Existing furnishing pendants remain readable as hidden legacy items. New rattan-bell-pendant instances are light devices and require the matching panel release.

history.summary: Soften rattan pendant lighting and lower its bulb into the shade chamber
breakingChanges: No saved data changes. Existing pendants retain their placement and size, with reduced light intensity and a lower bulb and emitter in the updated panel.

history.summary: Stabilize orbital wall lighting and TV screen layers; add comic-book flight artwork
breakingChanges: No saved fields or model IDs change beyond the previously released pendant support. Existing homes remain compatible; update the panel for stable toon lighting during camera movement and the TV rendering fix and animation.

history.summary: Add live weather, private source selection and Weather action previews
breakingChanges: Existing profiles default to automatic weather. Homes saving a weather source or Weather action require the matching updated panel; older panels retain the unsupported-field recovery path. Public exports omit HA weather identifiers.

history.summary: Add wall-owned niches with solid backing and shared Construct controls
breakingChanges: Existing homes remain compatible. Homes saving wall niches require an updated panel; older panels keep unsupported fields blocked until updated through HACS.

history.summary: Allow imports and Save with unavailable catalog variants using default visuals
breakingChanges: Existing projects remain compatible. Missing furnishing and device variants now produce warnings and render the model default while retaining the saved variant ID; missing models retain placeholders. Older panels can reject newer variants until updated through HACS. Structural and unsupported-schema errors remain blocked.

history.summary: Support reversible solid structural spaces in room properties
breakingChanges: Older clients must update before importing projects containing the room isSolid field.

history.summary: Add decorative apartment floors through Construct floor management
breakingChanges: Existing homes retain their appearance. Homes saved with apartmentFloor require a matching updated Home Assistant panel; older panels reject the new field. Solid structural spaces from revision 11 remain supported.

history.summary: Add outdoor room membership with shared room controls
breakingChanges: Existing homes, apartment floors and solid structural spaces remain supported. Homes saving platform useAsRoom or roomName fields require an updated panel. Older clients keep unsupported fields blocked until updated through HACS. No data migration is required.

history.summary: Unify model lighting authoring for personal and built-in models
breakingChanges: Existing homes and single-point imports remain supported. Model lighting overrides, independent light relationships, surface selections and glow-only settings require an updated frontend and matching native panel. No asset or backend migration is required; older clients retain unsupported-field protection.

history.summary: Support mixed light sources and remove fixed lighting cutoffs
breakingChanges: Existing point and strip declarations remain readable without migration. Mixed explicit source layouts and expanded sample counts require this updated frontend and matching native panel. Older clients retain unsupported-data protection. No asset, HA binding or backend migration is required.

history.summary: Keep misplaced items editable and add explicit placement repairs
breakingChanges: Existing homes remain compatible. The updated panel treats geometric placement diagnostics as warnings, checks scaled bounds before Arrange edits, and offers per-copy repairs in Issues. Older panels can still block a home on legacy device contact errors. No data or asset migration is required.

history.summary: Support independent furniture and device sensor readings with scene visibility and TV switch controls
breakingChanges: Existing homes remain supported. Furniture entitySlots and slot presentation.showInScene require the matching updated frontend and Home Assistant panel. Mixed model lighting and placement repairs from revisions 15 and 16 remain supported. Older clients retain unsupported-field protection.

history.summary: Add virtual room boundaries without physical geometry or collision
breakingChanges: Existing homes remain supported. Homes using WallSpec.virtual require the matching updated frontend and Home Assistant panel; older clients keep unsupported fields blocked. Mixed lighting, placement repairs and independent entity readings from revisions 15 through 17 remain supported.

history.summary: Keep native glow selections stable across model variants
breakingChanges: Existing homes and immutable GLB selections remain supported. Native keyed emissiveSurfaces require the updated frontend and matching HA panel. Old native ordinals remain saved but inactive until explicitly reselected. No asset, binding or schema-version migration is required.

history.summary: Keep dense model lighting renderable and isolate broken optional illumination
breakingChanges: Existing authored sources, sample counts, model identities and connections remain unchanged. Older panels can reject valid lighting above eight samples or with no physical output; update HACS, restart Home Assistant and reload the frontend. Runtime recovery disables only malformed optional lighting without rewriting saved data.

history.summary: Add persistent Arrange item groups
breakingChanges: Existing homes remain supported. Homes saved with scene-item group metadata require an updated frontend and matching Home Assistant panel. Groups preserve individual models, lighting and connections without a schema-version or asset migration; older clients retain unsupported-field protection.

history.summary: Allow eligible manual connections before room area setup
breakingChanges: No saved fields, slot IDs or schema versions change. Every eligible manual function and reading can now map across Home Assistant areas or before its room has an area association. Older clients may report these mappings as unmapped until their frontend or panel is updated; no migration or device command is involved.

history.summary: Conditional state visibility on models
breakingChanges: Update older Cabane clients and the Home Assistant integration before opening projects using if-present map visibility. Existing boolean visibility settings remain supported.
